notes.title: Michelangelo: Stonemason Simulator - Steam Next Fest Update
notes.notes:
[h1]🗿 Greetings, Sculptors! 🗿[/h1]

In preparation for Steam Next Fest on Monday, we’ve given our demo a fresh coat of paint!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509200/Michelangelo_Stonemason_Simulator  
[b]🎯 Here’s a quick overview of what’s new:[/b]  
[list]
[*] You now start straight at level 15 with a larger-radius golden chisel.  
[*] The first 15 skill points are invested in *Swift Hand* (chisel speed).  
[*] The 15-minute timer is gone; the demo now ends when you finish the first level.  
[*] XP gain has been doubled.  
[*] The UI has been reworked and includes a link to a feedback form.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560095/bb587b7e5790681c29232c2a291db96ebbb2da52.png[/img]

[b]🛠️ Plus a handful of smaller bug fixes:[/b]  
[list]
[*] The red preview mode now turns off automatically once a sculpture is complete.  
[*] The level panel in the upper-left now has a clean edge.  
[*] Fixed rare horizontal black lines on the marble.  
[*] Easier to reach the lower part of the sculpture while kneeling.  
[*] Rare cases of floating marble pieces have been resolved.  
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560095/1e1eded0212f7bb6c6fe0767f3afdb6efa962874.jpg[/img]

Add the game to your wishlist and check out the updated demo!

Have fun! 💝

Solid regards,  
Three River Games (3RG)
